settings.visualStyle: Grounded late Eastern Han historical reconstruction during the Yellow Turban Rebellion in 184 CE. Chest-mounted human-scale soldier POV, ordinary infantry experience, worn practical clothing and equipment, dusty roads, smoke, mud, fatigue, incomplete visual information and realistic human movement. No wuxia, no fantasy, no superhero generals, no game HUD and no centered FPS weapon.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Chest-mounted first-person POV. Scene N end state must physically match Scene N+1 start state. No spoken human voice, no words, no dialogue, no commands, no chanting, no narration and no music. Human vocal sound is limited to breathing and brief nonverbal exertion only.

audioHardLock.promptRule: Do not generate spoken human voices or intelligible language in any scene.

continuityLock.rule: Scene N continuityEndFrame must physically match Scene N+1 continuityStartState.

movie.storyTitle: EP01 — Yellow Turban Rebellion, 184 CE: The Rebellion Begins
movie.plotDetails: The viewer experiences the episode through an anonymous Han foot soldier. He is not a legendary hero and is never externally visible. The story focuses on marching, waiting, reacting, taking cover, surviving a short confused clash, helping a comrade and continuing onward.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a grounded late Eastern Han chest-mounted soldier POV during the Yellow Turban Rebellion of 184 CE. Nearby people ignore the viewer and behave naturally. Combat is brief, confused and survival-driven. No spoken human voices, no words, no dialogue, no commands, no chanting, no narration and no music. Human vocal sound is limited to breathing and brief nonverbal exertion only.
movie.storySummary: Before dawn an ordinary Han foot soldier wakes in camp, checks gear and joins a dusty march. Civilians, smoke and changing battlefield conditions reveal danger. The unit moves into fields, reacts to incoming arrows, compresses behind shields, advances in hesitant short movements, survives confusion near a village, helps a wounded comrade, observes crossbow support, catches breath and marches onward.
